## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- The first watermark-free export came out on B5 paper, each board shrunk into the top-left and
  cut off (the generator's named-paper bug, ad hoc todo on 29 Oct). Re-exported on Original (A1).
  It moves the credits board to page 2, and pages 50–52 are posters; acts start
  4/6/11/19/26/33/43, the book ends on 49 (`ac1f871`).
- `art/*.pdf` is now gitignored.
- F2: share button with the share sheet, else a Copy link / Save page menu; a 1200×630 card per
  page (the page on a blurred crop of itself, no text, so no fonts), and per-page Open Graph
  tags (`b9d7a4d`). Checked in desktop Chrome; WhatsApp/LINE cards need the production domain,
  since previews sit behind Vercel's login.
  Preview: https://riverbanks-microsite-iql4px5gs-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app/p/15
- F2 changed after Yan tried it in desktop Safari: the system sheet came first (no chat apps on a
  Mac) and closing it opened our menu too (Safari's NotAllowedError). Now our menu comes first,
  with the sheet as "More options…" (`c37a4fd`).
- F3 landing (`7cc1d31`): the cropped map with seven glowing markers, Sam's intro verbatim (the
  draft copy is gone), and a dev-only `/?place` for Yan to drag the markers to where each act
  happens. The positions are still the mockup's sketch. The "here" link is plain text until
  there's a target. Preview: https://riverbanks-microsite-rnzbwyo6a-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app
- F3 redesigned after Yan's review: "it has to work on tablet, phone and desktop".
  - Boards 10–14 on the mockup canvas, approved, then built (`48bc302`): the map full screen,
    the welcome in a translucent panel (left on wide screens, bottom on portrait), and a
    header that folds into a hamburger.
  - Get involved is a prominent button, pointing at Sam's Google Form (`/viewform`; Yan pasted
    the `/edit` link).
  - The credits moved to `/credits`.
- The map grew to Southeast Asia so the acts' rivers fit (`scripts/landing-map.py`, adapted
  from the generator's `sunda-maps.py`, ETOPO 2022, a new download and routing run).
  - Markers are now real places from the drafts. Muara is on the Muar (Yan).
  - Each act's river is traced downstream to the Ice Age coast and lights on hover.
  - The Prologue and Act One share one stop at the North Sunda River's mouth, which lights its
    whole basin.
  - Drowned stretches: Yan compared dots and four colours (`art/drowned-river-colours/`) and
    chose plain solid yellow.
- Getting the framing right took three map extents; the "never narrower than the screen" rule
  needs a map wider than the acts. Details in the F3 plan.
- The panel's scrollbar is now a quiet inset thumb. Preview:
  https://riverbanks-microsite-85rl5gxin-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app

- Google Analytics (G-VYMEDFZSE8) in app.html, off on localhost.
  - Events: `read_page` per page turned, `finish_book`, `share`, and `generate_lead` from the
    form (`e06f7cc`).
  - The test hits answered 503; check GA's Realtime report.
- F5, the cast page: 13 speaking characters, from each act's script (Yan: speaking roles only).
  - The portraits are cropped from the generator's turnaround sheets.
  - Each character has a link, `/cast#id`.
  - The one-liners need Sam's approval.
- F4, get involved: the Google Form was an empty, unpublished draft, which meant the Get
  involved button was broken for the public.
  - With Yan's OK, the questions went in through the Forms API and the form was published.
  - `/get-involved` asks them in three steps and posts to the form.
  - Taro grows up kitten → cat → beaing across the steps (Yan).
  - No real test response sent yet (needs Yan's OK).
- **Launched.** `comic-reader` fast-forwarded into `main` and deployed to production at Yan's
  request. www.riverbanks.lol serves the new site, with link cards live for WhatsApp and LINE.
